_comment: Every possible relationship structure an NPC can lean toward. 'weight' biases the deterministic per-NPC roll (higher is more common). 'mode' gates which styles are eligible given the NPC's current marital status: 'partnered' needs an active partner, 'solo' fits an unpartnered NPC, 'any' fits either. Consumed by NPCEmpathizeUI.js Romance tab.

styles.name: Monogamous
styles.desc: One exclusive partner at a time.
styles.desc_it: Un unico partner esclusivo alla volta.

styles.name: Civil union
styles.desc: A legally recognized partnership without a formal marriage.
styles.desc_it: Un'unione riconosciuta legalmente senza un matrimonio formale.

styles.name: Long-distance
styles.desc: A committed couple separated by geography.
styles.desc_it: Una coppia impegnata separata dalla distanza.

styles.name: Open relationship
styles.desc: A primary couple who agree to additional partners.
styles.desc_it: Una coppia principale che ammette altri partner.

styles.name: Polyamorous
styles.desc: Several loving relationships maintained openly and at once.
styles.desc_it: Piu relazioni amorose portate avanti apertamente e insieme.

styles.name: Companionate
styles.desc: Deep affection and partnership with little or no passion.
styles.desc_it: Affetto profondo e vita in comune, con poca o nessuna passione.

styles.name: Throuple
styles.desc: A committed relationship between three people.
styles.desc_it: Una relazione impegnata fra tre persone.

styles.name: Arranged marriage
styles.desc: A union arranged by families rather than chosen by the couple.
styles.desc_it: Un'unione combinata dalle famiglie piu che scelta dalla coppia.

styles.name: Portland Polycule
styles.desc: A sprawling, densely interconnected network of polyamorous partners, metamours and their exes, all somehow still on good terms.
styles.desc_it: Una vasta e fittamente interconnessa rete di partner poliamorosi, metamour e loro ex, tutti chissa come ancora in buoni rapporti.

styles.name: Serial monogamist
styles.desc: One exclusive partner at a time, in a long string of relationships.
styles.desc_it: Un partner esclusivo alla volta, in una lunga serie di relazioni.

styles.name: Contentedly single
styles.desc: Not seeking a partner and at peace with it.
styles.desc_it: Non in cerca di un partner e in pace con questo.

styles.name: Situationship
styles.desc: An undefined romantic entanglement that never quite becomes a relationship.
styles.desc_it: Un legame romantico indefinito che non diventa mai davvero una relazione.

styles.name: Friends with benefits
styles.desc: Casual intimacy between friends with no romantic commitment.
styles.desc_it: Intimita informale fra amici senza impegno romantico.

styles.name: Queerplatonic partnership
styles.desc: A committed bond stronger than friendship but not romantic.
styles.desc_it: Un legame impegnato piu forte dell'amicizia ma non romantico.

styles.name: Aromantic solo
styles.desc: Living by choice without any romantic partnership.
styles.desc_it: Vivere per scelta senza alcun legame romantico.
